name: stiff_arrhenius_jacobian
source:
{ A stiff 2x2 block that stresses the Jacobian. The Arrhenius factor
  exp(-Ea/(R#*T)) varies by orders of magnitude over the Newton path, so the
  entry dQ/dT is enormous next to dQ/dk = 1 - exactly the badly scaled case
  where a finite-difference Jacobian and an analytic one can disagree.
  A CSTR energy balance closes the loop: heat released = heat removed. }
GUESS T = 350
GUESS k = 1
Ea = 72000
A_pre = 1.2e10
dHr = 180000
UA = 2200
T_cool = 300
k = A_pre * exp(-Ea / (R# * T))
UA * (T - T_cool) = dHr * k
